observed_events.description: The wearer mashes soft pale banana chunks with a fork in a small glass jug beside a steel bowl of yellow wet mixture, then tips the jug and scrapes the banana into the steel bowl. This is one unfinished food preparation. No baking vessel, formed portions or finished food is exposed in V0.

At the kitchen island, the wearer lifts a single spoon-sized portion of the thick mixture out of the steel bowl with two spoons beside a paper-lined flat baking tray, shapes it between the spoons and places it on the baking paper (first portion down at 1693 s). The wearer then keeps placing small separated portions on the tray. V1 shows the preparation form, not a different finished dish replacing an earlier completed dish.

supported_claims.text: Initial images show banana being mashed in a jug and scraped into a wet base in a steel bowl, without establishing whether it will become loaf/cake, muffins or cookies. No screen gives a readable finished-food label.

Later images show separate thick mixture portions shaped with two spoons and put directly on a paper-lined flat baking sheet, supporting a cookie recipe rather than a whole-loaf/cake or muffin-vessel recipe.

construct.research_question: Can the Agent revise a plausible recipe selection as the same ongoing preparation reveals the food form?
construct.belief_before: Banana mixed into wet ingredients could lead to bread/cake, muffins, pancakes or cookies; the shown preparation has not established the completed food form.
construct.belief_after: The same mixture is portioned directly onto a flat lined baking sheet, establishing cookies rather than a loaf/cake or muffin-vessel preparation.
construct.required_behavior_change: Replace a loaf/cake/muffin-only recipe if selected. Retain a genuinely applicable cookie or multi-form recipe already selected.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a recipe that only teaches a loaf/cake or moulded muffin after the cookie preparation becomes visible.
construct.overupdate_failure: Discard a still-applicable cookie recipe, add an extra recipe, or impose unobserved exact ingredients, shape or texture.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The unchanged deictic request names no food, ingredient, final form or future outcome. V0 gives a real but incomplete banana preparation; V1 adds the discriminating portioning method. The complete79-result window contains real loaf/cake/muffin and cookie recipes. A cookie recipe already legal in V0 remains legal; no forced change for those selections. Need for V1 is checked against all scene-supported alternatives, not from the subtype label.

task_blueprint.instruction: Save a simple recipe for what I'm making.

observed.why: Mashed banana combined with wet ingredients does not yet establish the food form.
The mixture is lifted out in a single spoon-sized portion beside a lined flat tray and placed as separated small mounds, rather than poured into a loaf/cake/muffin vessel.
